ingredients:
salmon fillets
asparagus
lemon
garlic
olive oil
salt & pepper
description:
1. Heat oven to 400°F.
2. Toss asparagus with oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
3. Nestle salmon on the pan, top with garlic and lemon.
4. Roast 12–15 minutes until salmon flakes.

ingredients:
chicken breast
broccoli
rice
chicken broth
garlic
olive oil
description:
1. Brown chicken in a deep skillet.
2. Add rice, garlic, and broth; bring to a simmer.
3. Nestle broccoli on top, cover, and cook 15 minutes.
4. Fluff rice and serve.

ingredients:
ground beef
pasta
tomatoes
onion
garlic
basil
parmesan
description:
1. Boil pasta.
2. Brown beef with onion and garlic.
3. Stir in tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
4. Toss with pasta, basil, and parmesan.

ingredients:
tofu
spinach
soy sauce
garlic
ginger
rice
sesame oil
description:
1. Press and cube tofu; pan-fry until crisp.
2. Add garlic and ginger.
3. Wilt spinach and splash soy sauce.
4. Serve over rice.

ingredients:
eggs
cheddar cheese
bread
butter
chives
salt & pepper
description:
1. Toast bread.
2. Soft-scramble eggs in butter.
3. Fold in cheddar and chives.
4. Pile on toast and season.

ingredients:
shrimp
rice
garlic
butter
lemon
parsley
description:
1. Cook rice.
2. Sauté shrimp in butter and garlic.
3. Finish with lemon and parsley.
4. Serve over rice.

ingredients:
pork chops
apple
onion
mustard
olive oil
thyme
description:
1. Sear pork chops; set aside.
2. Soften apple and onion in the pan.
3. Stir in mustard and thyme.
4. Return pork to glaze and finish cooking.

ingredients:
chickpeas
cucumber
yogurt
lemon
olive oil
cumin
description:
1. Warm chickpeas with cumin and oil.
2. Dice cucumber.
3. Whisk yogurt with lemon.
4. Assemble bowls and drizzle.

ingredients:
ground turkey
kidney beans
tomatoes
bell pepper
onion
chili powder
description:
1. Brown turkey with onion and pepper.
2. Add tomatoes, beans, and chili powder.
3. Simmer 20 minutes.
4. Taste and adjust seasoning.

ingredients:
mushrooms
barley
carrot
celery
onion
vegetable broth
description:
1. Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and mushrooms.
2. Add barley and broth.
3. Simmer until barley is tender.
4. Season and serve hot.

ingredients:
chicken thighs
honey
mustard
garlic
olive oil
green beans
description:
1. Mix honey, mustard, and garlic.
2. Coat chicken and roast at 400°F for 25 minutes.
3. Roast green beans alongside.
4. Rest chicken briefly and plate.

ingredients:
cooked rice
eggs
peas
carrot
soy sauce
green onion
description:
1. Scramble eggs; set aside.
2. Stir-fry carrot and peas.
3. Add rice and soy sauce.
4. Fold in eggs and green onion.

ingredients:
black beans
tortillas
cheddar cheese
salsa
avocado
cumin
description:
1. Mash beans with cumin.
2. Fill tortillas with beans and cheese.
3. Toast until crisp and melted.
4. Serve with salsa and avocado.

ingredients:
cod
cherry tomatoes
olive oil
garlic
parsley
lemon
description:
1. Place cod in a baking dish.
2. Top with tomatoes, garlic, and oil.
3. Bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes.
4. Finish with parsley and lemon.

ingredients:
sweet potato
black beans
tortillas
cumin
lime
cabbage
description:
1. Roast cubed sweet potato with cumin.
2. Warm black beans.
3. Fill tortillas with potato and beans.
4. Top with cabbage and lime.

ingredients:
sausage
bell peppers
onion
olive oil
italian seasoning
bread
description:
1. Brown sausage slices.
2. Add peppers and onion.
3. Season and cook until tender.
4. Serve with toasted bread.

ingredients:
chicken drumsticks
potatoes
lemon
oregano
olive oil
garlic
description:
1. Toss chicken and potatoes with oil, lemon, oregano, garlic.
2. Roast at 425°F for 40 minutes.
3. Flip once for even browning.
4. Rest and serve.

ingredients:
noodles
peanut butter
soy sauce
cucumber
carrot
lime
description:
1. Cook and cool noodles.
2. Whisk peanut butter, soy, and lime.
3. Toss with noodles and shredded veg.
4. Chill briefly before serving.

ingredients:
white beans
kale
onion
garlic
vegetable broth
olive oil
description:
1. Sauté onion and garlic.
2. Add beans and broth; simmer.
3. Stir in kale until wilted.
4. Season and ladle into bowls.

ingredients:
chicken breast
flatbread
bbq sauce
red onion
mozzarella
cilantro
description:
1. Toss cooked chicken with BBQ sauce.
2. Top flatbread with cheese, chicken, onion.
3. Bake until bubbly.
4. Finish with cilantro.

ingredients:
beef strips
broccoli
soy sauce
sesame oil
garlic
rice
description:
1. Stir-fry beef quickly; set aside.
2. Cook broccoli until bright green.
3. Return beef with soy, garlic, sesame.
4. Serve over rice.

ingredients:
cauliflower
quinoa
chickpeas
tahini
lemon
olive oil
description:
1. Roast cauliflower and chickpeas.
2. Cook quinoa.
3. Whisk tahini with lemon.
4. Assemble bowls and drizzle dressing.

ingredients:
eggs
spinach
mushrooms
butter
cheese
salt & pepper
description:
1. Sauté mushrooms and spinach.
2. Pour beaten eggs into the pan.
3. Add filling and cheese; fold.
4. Slide onto a plate.

ingredients:
red lentils
carrot
onion
curry powder
coconut milk
rice
description:
1. Soften onion and carrot.
2. Add lentils, curry, and coconut milk.
3. Simmer until thick and tender.
4. Serve with rice.

ingredients:
chicken breast
tomatoes
mozzarella
basil
balsamic
olive oil
description:
1. Season chicken and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
2. Top with tomato and mozzarella.
3. Bake until cheese melts.
4. Finish with basil and balsamic.

ingredients:
zucchini
corn
eggs
flour
green onion
yogurt
description:
1. Mix grated zucchini, corn, egg, flour, onion.
2. Pan-fry spoonfuls until golden.
3. Drain on paper towel.
4. Serve with yogurt dip.

ingredients:
salmon
maple syrup
dijon
garlic
broccoli
olive oil
description:
1. Whisk maple, dijon, and garlic.
2. Brush on salmon.
3. Roast with broccoli at 400°F.
4. Serve when salmon is just cooked.

ingredients:
ground beef
tortillas
lettuce
tomato
cheddar
cumin
description:
1. Brown beef with cumin.
2. Warm tortillas.
3. Fill with beef and toppings.
4. Serve immediately.

ingredients:
pasta
white beans
cherry tomatoes
garlic
olive oil
spinach
description:
1. Cook pasta.
2. Sauté garlic and tomatoes.
3. Add beans and spinach.
4. Toss with pasta and oil.

ingredients:
chicken legs
potatoes
carrot
rosemary
olive oil
garlic
description:
1. Toss chicken and veg with oil, garlic, rosemary.
2. Roast at 425°F for 45 minutes.
3. Rest 5 minutes.
4. Plate with pan juices.
